entries.title: Jeremiah 29:5
segments:
Build ye houses; the expectation of a speedy restoration to their own land would have prevented the captives from settling themselves in their new abode, and thus have proved an injury to them. 
 
vv 5-6. 
 
The true teacher will inculcate upon me cheerful submission under the afflictive dispensations of God's providence and the diligent performance of duty.  Thus present suffering will be greatly mitigated, and the way be prepared for future enlargement and deliverance.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:7
segments: Since civil government is an ordinance of God, we are bound to seek the peace and welfare of the nation in which God's providence in any way appoints our residence, and to yield a willing obedience to all its laws, except only when they command what God forbids.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:8
segments:
vv 8-9. 
 
The way of those who prophesy lies has always been, first to quiet men's consciences in sin until they fall into trouble, and then to encourage them to seek deliverance from it in some other way than by repentance and submission to God's will.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:10
segments: If we bear with patience and meekness the trials which God lays upon us, he will, at the appointed time, grant us a glorious deliverance from them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:11
segments: An expected end; that happy issue which is the object of your hopes.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:13
segments: Heartiness and sincerity in seeking God insure a gracious answer.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:15
segments:
Prophets in Babylon; these were the false prophets who promised the captives a speedy return. 
 
vv 15-19. 
 
They who desire to be flattered in rebellion against God, will find false prophets ready to flatter them; but it will only be for their utter and irremediable ruin.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:22
segments: None do so much as false teachers to corrupt and ruin a nation; and against none does God threaten such severe judgments.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:23
segments: Lying words in doctrine, and villany in practice, generally go together, as in the case of Ahab and Zedekiah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:24
segments: Thus shalt thou also speak; this prophecy was evidently delivered after the return of Zedekiah's messengers from Babylon.
